# Indagium

> Indagium is a free, offline Android log viewer and logcat analyzer for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It opens saved logcat files and adb bug reports and captures live Android logcat with screen video over USB or Android 11+ wireless debugging. Its multi-format viewer also opens JSON and JSON Lines (NDJSON), CSV and TSV, syslog, automotive DLT, and other system and application logs. Custom profiles map fields from JSON, delimited logs, and regex-based text logs. Indagium filters, folds, compares, and annotates logs, with shared notes that link back to evidence across tabs. Capture snapshots default to compatible ZIP archives, with optional Indagium Compact (.ind) snapshots. Indagium is source-available under the PolyForm Perimeter License.

## Pages

- [Home](https://indagium.com/): Application overview, features, and downloads.
- [Supported log formats](https://indagium.com/#log-formats): Built-in profiles for JSON Lines, metadata JSON, Pino, Docker json-file, Kubernetes CRI, systemd journal JSON, syslog, dmesg, Apache and Nginx access logs, logfmt, Go slog text, and plain text. Set up CSV/TSV or define your own profiles, and expand structured records to inspect their fields.
- [Multi-format Log Viewer and Custom Profiles](https://indagium.com/log-formats/): Inspect JSON logs, check how a file was parsed, and create custom CSV, JSON Lines, or regex-based profiles.
- [Android Logcat Viewer](https://indagium.com/android-logcat-viewer/): Open and read large logcat text files, use the minimap and thread map, and compare tabs.
- [Android Logcat Analyzer](https://indagium.com/logcat-analyzer/): Filter, highlight, search, fold sequences, and export findings.
- [Sequence Diagrams](https://indagium.com/sequence-diagrams/): Create editable interaction diagrams from selected Android log rows or a filtered view, retain source evidence, and export an image snapshot or Mermaid/PlantUML source.
- [Android Logcat Capture](https://indagium.com/android-logcat-capture/): Capture Android logcat and screen video over USB or wireless debugging in one session that waits through reboots and temporary disconnects; review device-event timing and save ZIP by default or Compact capture archives.
- [Indagium Compact (.ind)](https://indagium.com/ind-format/): Compare ZIP and Compact capture archives, learn about lossless log compression and optional AV1 conversion, and open or extract capture evidence.
- [Third-party Licences and Notices](https://indagium.com/licenses/): Media, compression, and application library licences, and source preparation details.
- [AI Tests](https://indagium.com/ai-tests/): Build Android suites with reusable steps, scripts, checks, and setup hooks; run cases on device lanes, inspect saved evidence and reports, and follow up with issues.
- [Android Bug Report Viewer](https://indagium.com/android-bug-report-viewer/): Open adb bugreport .zip/.7z archives and choose logs to analyze.
- [Log Analysis Workflow](https://indagium.com/log-analysis-workflow/): Compare the analysis workspace with generic log viewers and manual video attachment.
- [Analyze Android Logcat Guide](https://indagium.com/guides/analyze-android-logcat/): A repeatable workflow for logcat, bugreports, and DLT.
- [DLT Viewer](https://indagium.com/dlt-viewer/): Supported DLT captures and their limitations.
- [Logcat MCP Server](https://indagium.com/logcat-mcp-server/): Optional loopback MCP integration, including approved Android device-capture tools.
- [Guides](https://indagium.com/guides/): Capture, saved-log, bugreport, and ANR guides.

- [Release 1.8.10](https://github.com/indagium/indagium/blob/master/docs/releases/1.8.10.md): AI test suites, configurable Find behavior, setup migration, and walkthrough documentation.
